name: Thomas Nguyen
psychographics: Community-focused; believes in supporting local business but is frustrated when logistics let the town down; enjoys being the 'go-to' guy for neighbors' repairs.
current_solutions: Uses Square for shop payments; orders inventory via a regional B2B app; delivers large items in his pickup truck to customers within a 20-mile radius.
frustration: Had a customer drive 45 minutes to buy a specific light fixture, only to find the delivery truck couldn't navigate the unpaved county road due to flooding, resulting in a lost sale and an angry phone call.
decision_style: Researches products online extensively; trusts user reviews on Home Depot more than sales pitches; willing to pay for reliability to avoid the drive.
voice: Confident and booming, uses retail jargon like "moving inventory" and "turnover"; can switch to a thick Southern drawl when telling a story about a regular customer.
